description: Offline toy runs of proof.md's algorithm with the shipped TagRho (toy.py, store keyed by the whole element): each instance runs walk after walk until it outputs x or has made 64 (floor(sqrt(r')) + 1) exits from the step loop (the toy exit cap). Seeds fixed before the runs: instance i of a row uses random.Random(4*10^7 + 1000 i + 10 window + digits per coordinate), target x drawn first from it; toy.offline_instance(family, m, window, i) reproduces any instance. All instances kept. steps = walk steps when the run stopped, per instance in instance order; the other fields are totals over the row's instances. The first 100 certified steps of every instance are compared with the exact selector and distinguished test (checked, check_failures).
